title: Set a default once with ??=
why_it_matters: It replaces a clunky if (x === undefined) block.
explanation: a ??= b means: assign b only if a is null or undefined. It's the short way to fill in a default. There's also ||= and &&=, but ??= is the safest because it keeps real values like 0 and an empty string.
try_it: Add a missing default to an object in your code using ??=.
